overview.name: Tuttle Capital Daily 2X Inverse Regional Banks ETF
overview.description: The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that are designed to provide, in the aggregate, 200% inverse (opposite) exposure to the price performance of the KRE ETF on a daily basis. The fund advisor seeks daily leveraged inverse investment results and the fund is very different from most other exchange-traded funds and presents different and greater risks. The fund is non-diversified.
